q: Which villages are cut off from a hospital, and how sure are you?
answer: The analysis finds 52 villages that are likely cut off by road from the nearest health facility, which for 30 of them is Rasuwa District Hospital. [F063] [F069] [F068] Ordered from most to least certain, the list starts with Amachhodingmo, Bahundanda, Betrawti, Bhainse and Bhanjyang and ends with Ratmate, Adamghat and Thansing. Certainty varies: Amachhodingmo has a 100% chance of being cut off, which means it was cut off in every simulated damage scenario. [F294] Thansing is the least certain, with a 55% chance. [F664] These are satellite estimates, not confirmed reports, and I can give you the full list or check any single village.

q: Which single repair would reconnect the most villages?
answer: Reopening the Pasang Lhamu Highway bridge is the top repair priority on the map [F2316, F2317]. It is not quite one repair: the ranking counts the bridge together with the other closed stretches on the same route [F2319]. Reopening that route would reconnect 18 villages that are likely cut off [F2320]. They are Amachhodingmo, Syapru Besi, Gatlang, Goljung, Chilime, Somdang, Gothen, Godam, Bahundanda, Tatopani, Nagathli, Gonggang, Brimdang, Gre, Jarsa Danda, Chyamdole, Tetangchet and Pangling [F2321]. These results are estimates from satellite images, so ground teams should check the damage before planning repairs.

The satellite analysis shows 59 bridges as likely destroyed, out of 353 bridges on the map [F027, F031]. Another 12 bridges were possibly damaged [F028]. Named bridges that are likely destroyed include Trishuli Naya Pul, Trishuli River Old Bridge, Belkhu Khola Bridge, Keurintar Hanging Bridge and devighat-Tadi bridge [F033]. These are estimates from radar images, so teams on the ground need to confirm them.

q: Can Syapru Besi still reach a hospital by road?
answer: Probably not. Syapru Besi is likely cut off by road, with a 100% cut-off chance, meaning it was cut off in every simulated damage scenario [F690, F691]. Its nearest health facility is Rasuwa District Hospital [F694]. Before the flood, the drive there took 54 minutes [F692]. Walking there now would take an estimated 1,773 minutes [F693].
Satellites cannot see deaths, injuries or missing people, so this map has no such figures. The District Emergency Operations Centre and Nepal Police keep those counts.

q: कति वटा गाउँ अस्पतालसम्म सडकबाट पुग्न सक्दैनन्?
answer: बाढीपछि ५२ वटा गाउँको स्वास्थ्य संस्थासम्मको सडक सम्पर्क टुटेको हुन सक्छ [F063]। यो सङ्ख्या भू-उपग्रहको तस्बिरबाट गरिएको अनुमान मात्र हो, पुष्टि भएको होइन। ती गाउँमध्ये १ वटा गाउँको सडक टुटे पनि त्यहाँबाट घण्टाभित्रै हिँडेर स्वास्थ्य संस्था पुग्न सकिन्छ [F065]। १०७ वटा गाउँबाट भने बाढीअघि पनि स्वास्थ्य संस्थासम्म नक्सामा सडक थिएन [F066]। सम्पर्क टुटेका ३० वटा गाउँका लागि सबैभन्दा नजिकको स्वास्थ्य संस्था Rasuwa District Hospital हो [F068, F069]।

नक्सा अनुसार पहिलो मर्मत प्राथमिकता Pasang Lhamu Highway bridge हो [F2316, F2317]। यो पुल र सोही बाटोका अन्य बन्द खण्ड खोल्दा सम्भवतः कटेका १८ वटा गाउँ फेरि जोडिन्छन्, जस्तै Syapru Besi, Gatlang, Chilime र Tatopani [F2319, F2320, F2321]। दोस्रो प्राथमिकता unnamed unclassified bridge र सोही बाटोका अन्य बन्द खण्ड हो, जसले ७ वटा गाउँ जोड्छ [F2322, F2325, F2326]। तेस्रो प्राथमिकता Pasang Lahamu bridge हो, जसले Timure र Rasuwagdhi सहित ६ वटा गाउँ जोड्छ [F2328, F2329, F2332, F2333]। यो क्रम भू-उपग्रह तस्बिरबाट गरिएको अनुमानमा आधारित छ, त्यसैले काम सुरु गर्नुअघि पुलको अवस्था स्थलगत रूपमा जाँच गर्नुहोला।
सडक वा पुल कहिले खुल्छ, वा अब के हुन्छ भनेर म अनुमान गर्न सक्दिनँ। नक्साले राडार तस्बिर लिइएको मितिको अवस्था मात्र देखाउँछ।
